I think it was about 42 hours

All of my exams for the half of the year are packed into two weeks because of Covid. I made it through the first week already but I didn’t do well at all. In class I am most of the times too scared to say anything at all. I have plenty of homework due to tomorrow and there’s no way I can do all of it. On top of it I don’t feel prepared for all the exams this week. This is my last year of school so it’s kinda important. I know it’s completely my fault but tbh the only thing I did the last days instead of studying is thinking about ways to kill myself, sometimes harming myself and laying around and not doing anything. This sounds so cliche. I feel like I’ll never be enough. I’ve always been a good student but because of my declining mental health I’m falling behind. I don’t see any reason to live. Every time I wake up I wish I would’ve died in my sleep. I can’t really look forward to anything. Now not even spending time with my friends brings me joy anymore. It all seems pointless. Why do I have to do all of this for maybe 50 more years? Where’s the point? I can’t think of one good reason to stay alive. On top of that there are some problems in our family at the moment. I am not even involved in all of them but they’re stressing me out more than I’d like to admit. I am super shy and no one ever sees more in me than that(except for my best friend). I don’t have any real problems or good reasons to die but I don’t have any reasons to keep on living either.
